answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to one physical device: joining requires a hardware-backed key whose attestation the protocol verifies, so a farm cannot spin up a thousand heads on one machine. Each extra fake costs a fresh device and its own attestation, and a caught device's key is burned forever — no reset, no resale. Honest agents gather in the oasis of shared work at dawn, each pearl of reputation earned on real hardware, and the price of faking the next head only climbs.
